On The 11th Of March, 2025

 Baban Singh Gond
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh Through P.S. Mada
 District Singrauli And Others
 Appearance:
 Mr. A.P. Shah - Advocate for applicant.
 Ms. Samta Jain - Government Advocate for State.
 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023/Section 439 of Cr.P.C., 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.840 of 2023 registered at Police Station-Mada, District-Singrauli (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 5L/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has falsely been implicated in this case.
The victim was major at the time of incident and she on her own volition accompanied the applicant.
There was a love affair between the applicant and the victim and relationships were established with consent.
The trial will take time to be concluded, hence, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

3. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application on NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:12226 2 MCRC-2306-2025
the ground that as per scholar register, the age of the victim was 17 years, 04 months and 11 days at the time of incident.
The applicant on the pretext of marriage and love, committed sexual intercourse with the prosecutrix, hence, the bail application filed by the applicant be dismissed.

4. Heard the parties and perused the case diary.
5.

Looking to facts and circumstances of the case and the trial will take time to be concluded, this Court deems it appropriate to enlarge the applicant on bail, therefore, without commenting on the Baban Singh Gond vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Through P.S. ... on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72993073/
1 merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
6.

entities.text: Baban Singh Gond vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Through P.S.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is directed that applicant-Baban Singh Gond shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.

7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
8.
Accordingly, Misc. Criminal Case stands disposed of.
